```{r load_data}
df_school <- read_csv("data/df_school.csv") |> 
  replace_na(list(churn = FALSE)) |> 
  select(
    organization_uuid,
    school_type,
    school_years_doing_innovamat
  )

df_classroom <- read_csv("data/df_classrooms.csv") |> 
  replace_na(
    list(lab_class = 0, lab_prep = 0, lab_gossip = 0, lab_not_classified = 0, 
         ave_class = 0, ave_prep = 0, ave_gossip = 0, ave_not_classified = 0)
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    # difference in years from today using lubridate
    classroom_age = floor(as.numeric(difftime(today(), classroom_created_at, units = "weeks")) / 52.25),
    teatcher_age = floor(as.numeric(difftime(today(), teacher_created_at, units = "weeks")) / 52.25),
    all_complete = as.integer(pack_type_ave == "TRUE" & pack_type_lab == "TRUE" & pack_type_app == "TRUE")
  ) |> 
  select(
    classroom_id = classroom_uuid,
    organization_id,
    students_age, 
    number_of_students,
    # starts_with("pack"),
    all_complete,
    starts_with("lab_"),
    starts_with("ave_"),
    total_sessions,
    total_sessions_lab = total_sessions_ab,
    total_sessions_ave,
    distinct_events,
    starts_with("minutes"),
    classroom_age,
    teatcher_age,
  ) |> 
  drop_na()

df_students <- read_csv("data/df_students.csv") |> 
  select(
    gender, 
    classroom_id,
    late_start,
    test_name,
    grade_percent,
    ends_with("24_25"),
    practica_adaptada
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider() 
  group_by(classroom_id) |> 
    summarise(
    # Variables categòriques/lògiques: percentatge de la primera categoria
    across(c(gender, late_start, practica_adaptada), 
           ~ mean(.x == levels(factor(.x))[1], na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
           .names = "{.col}_pct"),
    
    # Variables numèriques: mitjana
    across(c(grade_percent, ends_with("24_25")), 
           ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           .names = "{.col}_mean")
  ) 
```

```{r prepare_dataset}
all <- df_classroom |> 
  inner_join(df_students, by = join_by(classroom_id)) |> 
  select(-classroom_id) |> 
  group_by(organization_id) |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) |> 
  inner_join(df_school, by = join_by(organization_id == organization_uuid)) |> 
  mutate(
    school_years_doing_innovamat = if_else(
      is.na(school_years_doing_innovamat), ceiling(classroom_age), school_years_doing_innovamat)
    ) |> 
  filter(school_type %in% c("Public", "Charter", "Private")) |> 
  select(-school_type) |> 
  mutate(
    # Improve the distributions of some variables
    across(c(ave_class, ave_gossip, ave_not_classified, lab_class, lab_gossip, lab_not_classified, minutes_in_school_hours, minutes_out_of_school_hours), log1p)
    ) |> 
  rename(total_sessions_app = total_sessions_24_25_mean) |> 
  rename_with(~ stringr::str_remove(.x, "_24_25_mean")) |> 
  rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(.x, "semanas", "s")) |> 
  rename(
    s_sup_50_percent = s_con_media_superior_al_50_porciento,
    s_act_dist = s_de_actividad_distintas,
    school_years_IM = school_years_doing_innovamat,
    sessions_half_done = sessions_more_than_half_done
  ) |> 
  rename(
    grade_percentage = grade_percent_mean
  )
  
```

## Anàlisi de correlacions

```{r correlation_plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
cor_matrix <- all |>
  select(-organization_id) |>
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

# Visualitzar correlacions altes
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "circle", type = "upper", 
         order = "hclust", tl.cex = 0.7, tl.col = "black")

# Trobar correlacions molt altes (>0.9)
high_cor_pairs <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.9 & cor_matrix != 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
if(nrow(high_cor_pairs) > 0) {
  cat("\n=== CORRELACIONS MOLT ALTES (>0.9) ===\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(high_cor_pairs)) {
    row_name <- rownames(cor_matrix)[high_cor_pairs[i,1]]
    col_name <- colnames(cor_matrix)[high_cor_pairs[i,2]]
    cor_val <- cor_matrix[high_cor_pairs[i,1], high_cor_pairs[i,2]]
    cat(row_name, "-", col_name, ":", round(cor_val, 3), "\n")
  }
}
```

Traiem total sessions perquè ja tenim lab i ave sessions. Traiem també les dades de preparació, i sessions_at_home_24_25, total_sessions_24_25 i sessions_more_than_half_done_24_25.

```{r clean_variables}
all_clean <- all |> 
  # Traiem variables que correlacionen massa
  select(-c(
    total_sessions, 
    starts_with("ave"), 
    starts_with("lab"),
    sessions_at_home,
    total_sessions_app,
    sessions_half_done
    )
  )
```

```{r model_training, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Set up parallel processing
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

# Data preparation
data_split <- all_clean |>
  select(-organization_id) |>
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data  <- testing(data_split)

# Create preprocessing recipe
rec <- recipe(grade_percentage ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

# Create resampling folds for hyperparameter tuning
folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

# Model specifications
# 1. Regularized Linear Regression (Elastic Net)
linear_spec <- linear_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("glmnet") |>
  set_mode("regression")

# 2. Random Forest
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mtry = tune(),
  trees = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>
  set_mode("regression")

# 3. Boosted Model (XGBoost)
boost_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(),
  tree_depth = tune(),
  learn_rate = tune(),
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune(),
  sample_size = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("xgboost") |>
  set_mode("regression")

# Create workflows
linear_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rec) |>
  add_model(linear_spec)

rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rec) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)

boost_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rec) |>
  add_model(boost_spec)

# Hyperparameter grids
linear_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-10, 1)),
  mixture(range = c(0, 1)),
  levels = 10
)

rf_grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
  mtry(range = c(1, 15)),
  trees(range = c(200, 1000)),
  min_n(range = c(2, 40)),
  size = 20
)

boost_grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
  trees(range = c(100L, 500L)),
  tree_depth(range = c(2L, 5L)),
  learn_rate(range = c(0.01, 0.3)),
  mtry(range = c(2L, 10L)),
  min_n(range = c(10L, 20L)),
  sample_size = sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1.0)),
  size = 20
)

# Define metrics once to reuse across models
metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq, mae)

# Tune hyperparameters
linear_tune <- linear_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = linear_grid,
    metrics = metrics,
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

rf_tune <- rf_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = rf_grid,
    metrics = metrics,
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

boost_tune <- boost_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = boost_grid,
    metrics = metrics,
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

# View best parameters for each model
linear_best <- linear_tune |> select_best(metric = "rmse")
rf_best     <- rf_tune     |> select_best(metric = "rmse")
boost_best  <- boost_tune  |> select_best(metric = "rmse")

# Finalize workflows with best parameters
final_linear <- linear_wf |> finalize_workflow(linear_best)
final_rf     <- rf_wf     |> finalize_workflow(rf_best)
final_boost  <- boost_wf  |> finalize_workflow(boost_best)

# Fit final models
final_linear_fit <- final_linear |> fit(train_data)
final_rf_fit     <- final_rf     |> fit(train_data)
final_boost_fit  <- final_boost  |> fit(train_data)

# Evaluate on test set
test_results <- bind_rows(
  augment(final_linear_fit, test_data) |> mutate(model = "Linear"),
  augment(final_rf_fit, test_data)     |> mutate(model = "Random Forest"),
  augment(final_boost_fit, test_data)  |> mutate(model = "XGBoost")
)

# Performance metrics
test_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  rmse(truth = grade_percentage, estimate = .pred) |>
  arrange(.estimate)

test_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  rsq(truth = grade_percentage, estimate = .pred) |>
  arrange(desc(.estimate))

test_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  mae(truth = grade_percentage, estimate = .pred) |>
  arrange(.estimate)

# Variable importance / coefficients
final_linear_fit |>
  extract_fit_parsnip() |>
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  mutate(
    abs_estimate = abs(estimate),
    significant  = ifelse(abs(estimate) > 0.1, "High Impact", "Low Impact")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(abs_estimate)) |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(term, estimate), y = estimate, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Linear Regression Coefficients with Impact Classification",
    x = "Variables",
    y = "Coefficient Value",
    color = "Impact Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

cat("Random forest")
final_rf_fit |>
  extract_fit_parsnip() |>
  vip(num_features = 15) +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Variable Importance")

cat("Boosted model")
final_boost_fit |>
  extract_fit_parsnip() |>
  vip(num_features = 15) +
  labs(title = "Boosted Model Variable Importance")

# Stop parallel processing
plan(sequential)
```

```{r correlations_predictions, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Correlació entre predicció i valor real per a cada model
corr_tbl <- test_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(grade_percentage, .pred, use = "complete.obs")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(correlation)))

print(corr_tbl)

# Scatterplot de prediccions vs realitat

ggplot(test_results, aes(x = .pred, y = grade_percentage)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, colour = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Correlació entre prediccions dels models i grade_percentage",
    x = "Predicció del model",
    y = "grade_percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
